cases.prompt: Do an accessibility check on this component. No tool reports are available.
expectations: Treats this as a quick source scan and says that contrast, rendering and screen reader behavior still need a live or tool-based check.
Flags the missing alt text, the div used as a button, the unlabeled quantity input and the h4 heading level, each mapped to a WCAG criterion and ranked by severity.
Gives remediation with code examples, mentions what the component already does well, and includes a scorecard or summary.

cases.prompt: Here is the axe report for our login page. Give me the audit.
expectations: Ranks the missing password label first, then the 2.9:1 contrast on the forgot-password link (SC 1.4.3), then the landmark issue.
Gives concrete fixes for each, such as a <label for="password"> and a darker link color.
States that the report does not cover keyboard or screen reader behavior and lists the manual checks still needed, without claiming the page passes WCAG.
